lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to go up an Abarim mountain, see the land, and be gathered to his people.
The LORD says Moses and Aaron rebelled at the waters of Meribah in the Wilderness of Sinai.
Moses asks the LORD to appoint a man so the congregation will not be like sheep without a shepherd.
The LORD tells Moses to lay his hands on Joshua son of Nun and commission him before the congregation.
Moses has Joshua stand before Aaron the priest and the whole congregation, then commissions him.
